name: Developer API docs: answers a technical question exactly
description: A developer gets HTTP 429 errors. The API docs give the exact limit and header. The draft must quote the limit and the Retry-After header correctly and cite only the rate-limit page.

input.subject: Getting 429s
input.body: Our integration keeps getting HTTP 429 from your API since this morning. What is the limit, and how should we back off?

knowledge.title: Authentication
knowledge.content: Send your API key as a bearer token: Authorization: Bearer <key>. Keys are created under Settings, API keys.

knowledge.title: Rate limits
knowledge.content:
Each API key may make 100 requests per minute. Over the limit, the API answers 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header giving the seconds to wait.

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
```

Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After before retrying.

knowledge.title: Webhooks
knowledge.content: Webhooks are retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff if your endpoint does not answer 2xx.

knowledge.title: Pagination
knowledge.content: List endpoints return 50 items per page. Pass the next_cursor value to get the next page.

mock.text:
